recent transactions
account balance

update do

items.context: Kya aapne last month ki statement check ki hai?
items.text: han ji theek hai

items.context: Kya aapko apne account ki balance chahiye?
items.text: nahi bhai

items.context: Kya aap recent transactions dekhna chahte hain?
items.text: please bata do
mera account balance kitna hai abhi last update ke hisaab se
main apne recent transactions janana chahta hoon please check karo
kya aaj ke din koi paise meri account se kat gaye hai
please mujhe apna current balance bata do
kya aap bata sakte ho mera balance aur aakhri 5 transactions
main dekhna chahta hoon ki kitne paise mere account mein hain
kya main apne account ka balance sms ke through le sakta hoon

items.context: Kya aapko apne recent transactions dekhne hain?
items.text: main apne aakhri 10 transactions check karna chahta hoon

items.context: Kya aapko account balance update chahiye aaj ka?
items.text: mera balance kal se update hua hai kya

items.context: Kya main aapko recent transactions bhej doon?
items.text: please mujhe last 7 din ke transactions bhej dein

items.context: Main aapka current account balance bata doon?
items.text: abhi mera balance kya hai, mujhe ek baar bata dein

items.context: Kya aap apni account statement email karwana chahte hain?
items.text: main apne account ki statement mail karwana chahta hoon
mera account number 1234567890 hai aur main apna balance janna chahta hoon aaj ki date ke hisab se
last week se meri account mein koi transaction nahi hua hai kya main apne daily balance check kar sakta hoon
mere account se kuch paise bina meri ijazat ke kat gaye hain mujhe pata karna hai ki ye transactions asli hain ya fraudulent

items.context: Aap apne account balance aur recent transactions janna chahte hain kya?
items.text: main janna chahta hoon ki mere account mein kitne paise bache hain aur recent transactions kis date tak hain

items.context: Kya aapko balance ke sath recent transactions bhi chahiye?
items.text: mera account balance verify karna hai aur mai chahta hoon ki aap mujhe latest 10 transactions bata dein please

items.context: Aap mujhe apne account ki details batana chahte hain, balance aur transactions dono?
items.text: kya aap mere account se aaj tak ke paise ki details aur balance confirm kar ke bata sakte hain mujhe bahut zarurat hai ye sab jankari kiya hai ya nahi hua hai kisi transaction mein problem nahi aayi hai na mujhe bataiye please thank you very much for help in advance.

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: balance_enquiry - asks for their account balance or recent transactions
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
